migration_blockers.what: The frozen LM01 launch gate refuses any ops/work_orders/archive MWO file as its carrier: it requires a MANIFEST.md in the directive's directory. So MWO-0001 s7's 'MWO satisfies direct-chat' meets a frozen implementation expecting another carrier. It fails closed. Resolution options A (verbatim transcription + manifest, no freeze change) / B (gate repair, v0.3.3 re-freeze) await the operator.

The Fabric claude executor has no shell/python by design, so code-execution replicas need a separate script-executor Task over a committed file. Not a Fabric defect; a task-design constraint seats must know.
